summary: Sega's stretch-arm star platformer, with a Genesis original and a distinct Game Gear adaptation that changes level design and content.

entries.title: Ristar
entries.definitive_edition: Owned PC Sega Classics release, with official Genesis/Switch Online alternatives

emulation.emulator: SEGA Classics wrapper, Genesis Plus GX, or original hardware
emulation.notes: Use an official owned PC/Switch/mini-console route when possible; Genesis emulation is straightforward for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive original presentation with emulator scaling and filters.

primary.version: SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics / owned Steam release
primary.why: The Genesis version is the main game, and the PC Sega Classics release is the best capture-friendly route when already owned, with modern emulator wrapper features; select Classics bundles were delisted after December 6, 2024, so ownership/access matters.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PC Sega Classics copy for capture if available. If not, use the original Genesis/Mega Drive cartridge, Nintendo Classics/Switch Online, Sega Genesis Mini 2, or another official compilation route.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but PC/classic-emulation routes are easier for capture when owned.

all_releases.fidelity: Included across Sonic/Sega-themed compilations on multiple platforms.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful access routes, but not as capture-flexible as owned PC Sega Classics.
skip: official digital route, now less convenient than modern options.

all_releases.fidelity: SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics release for PC.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture-friendly official route when already owned, with delisting caveat.
skip: official mobile access, but touch/mobile presentation is not ideal for the main run.
skip: current official access route, but PC is preferred when already owned for capture workflow.
skip: official mini-console route, but less flexible than PC capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Genesis game content is preserved across official emulated routes; access is the main caveat after Sega Classics delisting.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated classic rather than a remaster; select Classics games and bundles were delisted after December 6, 2024 but remain downloadable for owners.

entries.title: Ristar (Game Gear)

emulation.emulator: Game Gear hardware or Genesis Plus GX-compatible emulator
emulation.notes: Use the Japanese ROM/cartridge for complete content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Game Gear presentation with emulator scaling.

primary.why: The Game Gear version is a largely different game with remixed and new level design; the Japanese release is the most complete handheld version because the North American release cut the second Fanturn level.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese Game Gear release on hardware or accurate Game Gear emulation. Use the western release only for localization comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Japanese Game Gear release with the full handheld level set.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete version of the distinct Game Gear game.
skip: localized route, but the North American release cut one Fanturn level.

all_releases.fidelity: Plug-and-play rerelease of the Game Gear version.
all_releases.reason: skip: archival rerelease, but the Japanese Game Gear original is the full handheld content route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Western localization access conflicts with completeness because the North American release cut a level.

entries.remaster_caveats: No full modern rerelease of the Game Gear version is documented beyond the Sonic's PlayPal Plug and Play inclusion.
